summary_of_analysis: Compared, operation by operation, every state access that src/uarch-step.cpp, src/uarch-reset-state.cpp and src/send-cmio-response.cpp make, across the native uarch (uarch_state_access -> machine::read_word/write_word/write_unverified_tlb/reset_uarch/putchar), the honest builder (collect_uarch_cycle_hashes_state_access and the inlined reset of collect_uarch_cycle_root_hashes), the log producers (uarch_record_state_access, record_send_cmio_state_access), the C++ replays (uarch_replay_state_access, replay_send_cmio_state_access) and the regenerated Solidity (UArchStep, UArchReset, SendCmioResponse, EmulatorCompat, AccessLogs, Memory, Buffer, MetaStep). Checked: alignment requires of readUint8/16/32/64 and writeUint* (identical in C++ and Solidity); register index arithmetic (UARCH_X0_ADDRESS + (uint8 index << 3), max 31 -> 248 fits uint8); ECALL numbers 1/2/4 and arguments a0-a4/a7; write-TLB index check (set >= 3 || slot >= 256) present on all paths of the regenerated step and native write_unverified_tlb (set > TLB_LAST_, slot >= 256); slot address and slot leaf contents {vaddr_page, vp_offset, pma_index, 0} identical in native, replay and Solidity; native write_unverified_tlb's extra mark_write_tlb_dirty_page cannot throw ('TLB is corrupt') because init_hot_tlb_slot verifies an UNVERIFIED slot first and hot slots are always consistent with the shadow; putchar is noexcept natively and a no-op elsewhere; uarch halt/cycle-overflow precedence identical; Solidity checked arithmetic (cycle+1, copyBits, writeTlbECALL sums) unreachable for overflow; reset writes the 2^22 uarch-state node with the pristine hash everywhere, and the native reset leaves only zero bytes outside registers/RAM (uarch_processor_state padding, address-range check forbids ranges in the node gaps); revert condition (iflags_Y != 0 and manual/rx-rejected tohost) identical in C++, Solidity and is_rejected_manual_yield used by the builder; send_cmio_response no-op conditions, writeLengthLog2Size rounding, imcyclemax saturation, fromhost encoding and rx-buffer region identical in native, replay and Solidity; access-log proof shape checks (make_proof sizes) prevent sub-leaf proofs. Native refusal set of write_word (misaligned, x0, mvendorid/marchid/mimpid, unknown shadow slots incl. revert-root-hash word, uarch_x0 and unknown uarch slots, shadow TLB and other protected DIDs, PMA array (host read-only), devices, gaps and sentinel, host-read-only flash/nvram) versus verifiers that accept all of them: this is exactly R1-R10-1 (read-only flash/nvram is a configuration-dependent sub-variant its fix section already discusses). Native read_word accepts every aligned address (zeros for gaps/devices); the only verifier refusal is the top leaf, R1-R10-2; no other Solidity bound or assert rejects an address the native reads. Also checked uarch-program-side asymmetry: uarch/Makefile does not define NDEBUG and uarch-runtime.hpp maps assert to abort (ebreak = deliberate uarch trap), so assert_no_brk (after every inner-loop iteration and after raise_interrupt_if_any), the final mcycle assert of interpret() and get_highest_priority_irq_num's assert(false) are live in the pristine uarch (strings present in uarch-ram.bin), while native interpret.cpp is built with -DNDEBUG in relwithdebinfo/release. This is a native-continues/uarch-traps asymmetry in principle, but I could not construct any state, even with arbitrary register values, that violates those asserts: reads of mip/mie/mideleg/mstatus are WARL-masked in i_state_access, interpret() clears iflags_X and returns early on H/Y, every writer of interrupt-relevant state (CSR mstatus/sstatus/mie/sie/mip/sip/mideleg, MRET/SRET, CLINT msip/mtimecmp, PLIC claim/complete) returns success_and_serve_interrupts when it can raise a pending-enabled interrupt, and raise_exception clears MIE/SIE of the target level. With no demonstrable triggering state it is not reported as a candidate.
experiments: Read-only analysis plus inspection of the built uarch image (strings of uarch/uarch-ram.bin show the assert_no_brk and final-mcycle assert texts, confirming asserts are compiled into the pristine uarch). No EVM run was needed: every asymmetry found reduces to R1-R10-1 or R1-R10-2, whose tests already exercise the EVM harness.
not_covered: Did not run new EVM/C++ differential experiments; all conclusions in this angle come from reading the generated Solidity and the C++ state-access layers side by side (the earlier R2 DFPROOFSOL/DFGUESTSTATE differential runs and the R1-R10-1/R1-R10-2 tests cover the dynamic side).

The released (non-regenerated) machine-solidity-step v0.17.0-test1 lacks the write-TLB index check, so it accepts write_tlb ECALLs with set_index 3 or slot_index >= 256 (writing shadow padding 0x7000.. or a neighbouring set) that native refuses; not reported because the AUDIT.md component table makes the regenerated step the referee verifier and Dave's own pinned machine/step is replaced by it.

Uarch stores into a read-only flash drive or nvram (host_read_only) are refused natively and accepted by both verifiers; judged a configuration-dependent sub-variant of R1-R10-1 (its fix section already discusses flash drives), not re-reported.
Main-processor step logs (log_step/verify_step, replay_step_state_access) were not compared: ZK-only, out of scope.
Dave CartesiStateTransition's composition of step, reset and send_cmio_response (counter-to-form map, revert-hash argument, full-consumption check) was not re-audited; earlier rounds covered it.

Uarch-only asserts in soft-float.hpp and the address_range/mock_address_range constructors (abrt -> ebreak on inconsistent PMA entries) were only reasoned about: PMA entries are fixed at creation, validated, and read-only to the guest, so the native/uarch asymmetry there needs an unreachable PMA table; not pursued further.

The honest builder collect_uarch_cycle_root_hashes throws on uarch cycle overflow while log_reset_uarch and the verifiers define the reset successor of an overflowed (non-halted) uarch; consistent with R5 and only relevant if R4's halting bound fails, which is the R4/R12 angles' question (worst-case uarch cycles per mcycle) and was not measured here.
Gas boundedness of the Solidity verifiers under real block gas limits and Solidity compiler-setting dependence were not examined.
JSON/Lua/C API decoding of access logs into the C++ replays was not fuzzed under this angle.
